title: hcbic: How much data does it take to test an expert causal diagram?
description: An R package and analysis that asks how many observations are needed to recover, or to contradict, an expert-elicited causal diagram of an agroforestry and livelihoods system. It simulates data from the expert model, runs hill-climbing structure learning scored by the Bayesian information criterion, and reports recovery of the diagram and the power to detect each missing arc.
